mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.spec_json, c.sku_code, c.quantity, c.name, c.image, c.price, c.description, c.insurance_detail, c.insurance_fee, c.created_at, c.updated_at, COALESCE(s.stock, p.stock) AS stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT id, user_id, product_id, sku_id, spec_json, sku_code, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, product_id, sku_id, spec_json, sku_code, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at, updated_at FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, sku_id, spec_json, sku_code, quantity, name, image, price, description, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{specJson}, #{skuCode}, #{quantity}, #{name}, #{image}, #{price}, #{description}, #{insuranceDetail}, #{insuranceFee}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, sku_id = #{skuId}, spec_json = #{specJson}, sku_code = #{skuCode}, name = #{name}, image = #{image}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, insurance_detail = #{insuranceDetail}, insurance_fee = #{insuranceFee}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
